title: Automotive Showroom Material Tuning Studio
description: You are a materials engineer in a luxury automotive showroom. A car paint sample panel and designer sunglasses sit on a turntable. You must tune clearcoat intensity, roughness, metalness, base color, and tint across both objects while maintaining a shared energy conservation law: the sum of reflectivity and absorption across both materials must equal a constant budget. Undo/redo lets you experiment freely.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load SunglassesKhronos.glb and ClearCoatCarPaint.glb via GLTFLoader and place them side-by-side on a circular platform (flat cylinder) centered at origin. Position the sunglasses on the left and car paint panel on the right, both scaled to similar visual size. Use OrbitControls for camera rotation. Add an HDR-style environment using PMREMGenerator with a procedural sky (three addons RGBELoader or simple CubeTexture gradient). Add two directional lights and one ambient light.

Interaction requirements (10-14 steps expected): Provide an HTML/CSS overlay panel with these coupled sliders: (1) Sunglasses lens clearcoat intensity 0-1, (2) Sunglasses lens roughness 0-1, (3) Car paint clearcoat intensity 0-1, (4) Car paint metalness 0-1, (5) Shared base color picker affecting both objects, (6) A tint hue slider 0-360 applied as an emissive tint to both. Implement an energy conservation constraint: sunglasses_clearcoat + carpaint_clearcoat must always equal exactly 1.0. When one slider moves, the other auto-adjusts inversely. Similarly, roughness + metalness across the two objects must sum to 1.2 max; clamp the second if exceeded. Display the current energy budget numerically.

Implement full undo/redo: store material state snapshots in an array on every slider release. Provide Undo and Redo buttons (also Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z). Limit history to 30 entries. Add a Reset button restoring defaults. Traverse each loaded GLTF scene to find all Mesh children and apply MeshPhysicalMaterial properties (clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, roughness, metalness, color, emissive). Animate a slow turntable rotation on the platform. Render at 60fps with tone mapping set to ACESFilmic and outputColorSpace sRGB.
